name: VigIA
author: Fernando Tellado

sections.description:
VigIA is a comprehensive analytics plugin that tracks and monitors AI crawler visits to your WordPress site. Understand how AI systems like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and others are accessing your content.

Key features

  • 50+ AI Crawlers Detected – Monitors major AI crawlers including GPTBot (OpenAI), ClaudeBot (Anthropic), PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Bytespider, and many more.

  • Visual Analytics Dashboard – Interactive charts showing crawler activity over time, visits by category, and detailed statistics.

  • Period Comparison – Compare crawler activity between different time periods to identify trends.

  • Custom Crawlers – Add your own crawler patterns to monitor additional bots not included by default.

  • Data Export – Export your crawler data to CSV for further analysis.

  • Dashboard Widget – Quick summary widget showing recent AI crawler activity right on your WordPress dashboard.

  • Privacy Focused – All data is stored locally in your WordPress database. No external tracking or third-party services.

Crawler categories

VigIA organizes crawlers into meaningful categories:

  • AI Training – Crawlers collecting data for model training (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot)
  • AI Search – Search-focused AI crawlers (PerplexityBot, OAI-SearchBot)
  • AI Assistant – Real-time assistant crawlers (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User)
  • Data Scraper – General data collection bots (Diffbot, Bytespider)

Use cases

  • Monitor which AI companies are accessing your content
  • Track how often AI crawlers visit your site
  • Identify which pages are most interesting to AI systems
  • Make informed decisions about robots.txt rules
  • Analyze AI crawler trends over time

Support

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/vigia/ or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Access the analytics dashboard via the ‘VigIA’ menu item in your admin sidebar.

The plugin starts tracking AI crawler visits immediately after activation.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. VigIA only processes requests from AI crawlers, which are a tiny fraction of your total traffic. The detection happens early in the request lifecycle and is highly optimized.

Where is the data stored?

All data is stored in your WordPress database in a custom table. No data is sent to external servers.

Can I export my data?

Yes! You can export all crawler visit data to CSV format for any date range you select.

How can I block AI crawlers?

VigIA is focused on monitoring and analytics. For blocking crawlers, we recommend using your robots.txt file or our companion plugin “AI Content Signals” which lets you control how AI systems can use your content.

What happens to my data if I uninstall?

By default, your data is preserved. You can choose to delete all data on uninstall in the plugin settings.
